author: Christopher_R

title: Fun way to sightsee
text:
Great way to see lots of Barcelona in a short time. We booked this for our teenagers and we all enjoyed it.

We also have a 9 yr old who loved it too. Booked it bc we didn’t see any age restrictions but apparently you have to be 16 yrs to ride an electric scooter in Barcelona.

The guide was very accommodating and we were all able to enjoy the tour in the end. 

Thank you!
author: Christine_G
